findings.evidence: Line 137-138 `@[deprecated (since := "2026-07-27")] alias inversions_ncard_mul_ofIdx := ncard_inversions_mul_ofIdx`; roadmap Suggested.lean:82 names the sorry-target `inversions_ncard_mul_ofIdx`; every other repo deprecation (e.g. Trace.lean:120) forwards a genuinely old name.
findings.fix: Name the theorem `inversions_ncard_mul_ofIdx` directly (no alias), or drop the alias and expose only `ncard_inversions_mul_ofIdx`. A rename with no predecessor needs no deprecated shim.
findings.issue: `inversions_ncard_mul_ofIdx` (the roadmap-pinned target name) is introduced solely as a `@[deprecated]` alias of `ncard_inversions_mul_ofIdx`. It has no prior version, so the deprecation is vacuous: it emits a warning for any consumer using the roadmap name and pollutes the public surface with a warning-only symbol.

findings.fix: Add `@[simp]`; the rewrite is terminating and reduces to the underlying `reflectionPerm`.
findings.issue: `weylGroupToPerm_ofIdx_apply` is a normal-form lemma eliminating the `ofIdx` wrapper (`weylGroupToPerm (ofIdx P i) j = reflectionPerm i j`) but is not tagged `@[simp]`; it is already needed via `rw` in Basic.lean's `inversions_ofIdx`.

summary: The API surface is otherwise minimal and well-characterized, but the roadmap's named target is shipped only as a `@[deprecated]` alias with no predecessor, delivering the pinned product in a warning state. One wrapper-elimination lemma should also carry `@[simp]`.
